note: Realistic filled-in states in the scoring engine's shape. `expected` is computed by `bin/test-personas --update` and verified by `bin/test-personas`. `gradeLegalRisk` distinguishes a *justified* decline (rationale recorded, a real decline-reason category other than 'not-reasonable') — capped at 'caution' via R-LEGAL-DECLINE-JUSTIFIED — from a decline with no rationale and no alternative, which independently trips two separate high-risk rules. The second persona below isolates the justified-decline caution path; the third isolates the unjustified, escalated high-risk path. Also notable, verified directly: `deriveRecommendation`'s waterfall bottoms out at 'implement' for a declined response with nothing agreed and no escalation — there is no dedicated 'decline acknowledged' outcome, a genuine engine quirk, not an authoring choice.

personas.name: fully-agreed-ok-risk-review-scheduled-complete
personas.description: A manager agrees in full to a software engineer's ADHD adjustment request (headphones, a quiet desk, written meeting summaries) following a meeting, with a review scheduled and responsibilities assigned: expect fully-agreed outcome + ok legal risk + 100% completeness + review-scheduled follow-up (targeted at the review date) + implement.

decision.decisionRationale: All requested adjustments are low-cost and straightforward to implement; agreed in full following a meeting with the worker.

adjustments.agreedAdjustmentsDetail: Noise-cancelling headphones, a quiet-zone desk away from the main walkway, and written meeting summaries, as requested.

support.supportResourcesDetail: ACAS neurodiversity adjustments guidance shared with the worker and manager.
support.responsibilitiesDetail: IT to order equipment by 2026-08-29; facilities to relocate the desk by 2026-08-29; manager to circulate written meeting summaries from 2026-09-01.

firedRules.description: All requested adjustments agreed.
No elevated discrimination risk detected.
Review scheduled for the agreed adjustments.

personas.name: declined-justified-caution-not-high-risk-complete
personas.description: A manager declines a customer service advisor's request for a dedicated buddy/mentor role, recording a clear rationale (disproportionate cost — no such post exists in the team structure) and a real decline-reason category: `declineJustified` requires a recorded rationale AND a decline-reason category other than 'not-reasonable', which caps this at R-LEGAL-DECLINE-JUSTIFIED (caution) rather than either of the two high-risk decline rules (no-rationale, no-alternative) — expect declined outcome + caution legal risk + 75% completeness + none follow-up + implement (the engine's waterfall fallback for a declined response with nothing agreed and no escalation).

decision.decisionRationale: A dedicated buddy/mentor role is not operationally available in the current team structure and would require a new permanent post; extra time on written summaries was already standard practice for the whole team, so no specific adjustment was required.

support.pointOfContact: Diane Foster, Customer Support Team Leader

signOff.notes: Worker was informed of the right to raise a grievance if unhappy with this decision.

personas.name: declined-unjustified-escalated-high-risk-incomplete
personas.description: A warehouse operative's adjustment request was declined verbally in a rushed meeting with no rationale recorded and no alternative offered; the worker has now raised a formal grievance: an unjustified decline (no rationale) and a decline with neither justification nor alternative are two independently-firing high-risk rules, and the active escalation adds a third — escalation also auto-escalates follow-up urgency ahead of the legal-risk check itself, and drives the recommendation straight to escalate-to-hr; the decision rationale, review arrangements, point of contact, and manager fields are not yet completed — expect declined outcome + high-risk legal risk + 38% completeness + escalation-needed follow-up + escalate-to-hr.

signOff.escalationDetail: Worker has raised a formal grievance disputing the decision to decline all requested adjustments; grievance hearing being scheduled.
signOff.notes: Decision made verbally in a rushed meeting; no written rationale was recorded at the time.
